mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 53 degrees with clear skies under the New Moon at Verona City Hall.

City officials are reminding residents that the upcoming General Election is scheduled for November 3rd, and the Citizen Police Academy is now accepting applications for a nine-week program starting September 23rd.
Today, athletes are racing in the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival, and there is live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness.
On Wednesday, September 10th, Verona police responded to a burglary in progress on Hunter's Cove Way, leading to the arrest of a 19-year-old suspect.
Today's flavor of the day is Really Reese's. The store is closed right now but will open today at 10:00 AM, and it remains open until 10:00 PM.
